rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone actively knocks an object over.

example.english: They topple the stool with one push.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teoi1 zau6 teoi1 lam1 zo2 zoeng1 dang3

rows.note: Use this when an object or pile topples or collapses by itself.

example.english: The stack of books could topple over at any moment.
example.traditional: 疊書擺得唔穩，隨時會冧晒。
example.jyutping: dip6 syu1 baai2 dak1 m4 wan2 ceoi4 si4 wui5 lam3 saai3

rows.note: Use this for a person or object that is tottering or leaning and is about to fall.

example.english: The table is leaning badly and is about to topple.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 ce3 saai3 zau6 lai4 dit3 dai1 laa3
